card.title: TYPE 94 TK
card.text: Deployment: Add a SURPRISE ATTACK to your hand.
card.flavorText: The Type 94 TK was a Japanese tankette used by the Imperial Japanese Army during WWII and earlier conflicts. The Type 94 TK was produced from 1935-1937 and 823 units were produced. It was rarely used in combat since it had a very thin armor and was armed only with a single machine gun. Some Type 94 TK’s were used as ammunition tractors, but most were used for general infantry support. Many were attached to infantry divisions in Tankette Companies and used for reconnaissance. Tankette’s were considered obsolete by most Western armies when WWII started, but even so the Type 94 TK was used in front line service by the Japanese until 1945.
